subject: general
question:
In the following question, the first and the last parts of the sentence/passage are numbered 1 and 6. The rest of the sentence/passage is split into four parts — P, Q, R, and S. These four parts are not given in their proper order. Read the sentence/passage and find the most logical order of the parts between 1 and 6.

Artificial Intelligence is reshaping industries.

P: It also improves customer service through automation.

Q: In healthcare, it helps in quick diagnosis.

R: Al systems reduce human error in complex calculations.

S: From manufacturing to medicine, its impact is visible.

6. Its future role will only expand.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• The paragraph begins by introducing the impact of Artificial Intelligence (AI) across industries, then dives into specific applications and benefits.
 
• **Sentence S is the first sentence** as it sets the broader context of AI's impact across various fields: 
 
 
• "From manufacturing to medicine, its impact is visible."
 
 
 
• **Sentence Q follows** as it highlights AI's significant contribution to healthcare: 
 
 
• "In healthcare, it helps in quick diagnosis."
 
 
 
• **Sentence R is the third sentence** as it emphasizes AI's role in reducing human error: 
 
 
• "AI systems reduce human error in complex calculations."
 
 
 
• **Sentence P is the fourth** as it discusses AI's contribution to customer service: 
 
 
• "It also improves customer service through automation."
 
 
 
• The correct sequence is **SQRP**.

 

**Coherent paragraph after rearrangement:**

"Artificial Intelligence is reshaping industries. From manufacturing to medicine, its impact is visible. In healthcare, it helps in quick diagnosis. AI systems reduce human error in complex calculations. It also improves customer service through automation. Its future role will only expand."
